exposure: Laparotomy with wedge resection of the scar ectopic
Asymptomatic patients with low serum β-hCG levels(<15,000 mIU/ml)
Patients treated with methotrexate (single or 4 doses)
Patients treated with laparotomy and wedge resection
cohort: 22 women diagnosed with Cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (SEP)
finding: Early diagnosis and treatment of SEP, including methotrexate or surgery, resulted in a high primary treatment success rate (91%) and minimized morbidity and mortality.
